# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Template
- [ ] Protocol
- [ ] Example
- [ ] Code
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Other

## Reviewability

- [ ] The change has one clear objective.
- [ ] The diff is small enough to review.
- [ ] No unrelated cleanup was included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated if needed.
- [ ] Tests or validation steps are listed if relevant.

## Public Safety

- [ ] No secrets or credentials.
- [ ] No private personal data.
- [ ] No employer-confidential information.
- [ ] No customer or vendor data.
- [ ] Examples use fake or sample data only.

## Validation

Explain how this was checked.

## Notes for Reviewers

Add assumptions, tradeoffs, or open questions.
